correctness.rationale: Independent canonical noises give total log-noise \(N(V/2,V)\) with \(V=\sum_k\Delta_k^2/\mu_k^2\). Disjoint adjacency gives product log sensitivity \(\Delta_{\max}\), so the sharp equal-variance Gaussian shift parameter is \(\Delta_{\max}/\sqrt V\). Hence \(2L\mu_{\rm prod}^2=\Delta_{\max}^2\), and the cap frontier is exactly the scalar constraint \(V\ge\max\{V_0,T\}\), attained by lowering one \(\mu_k\) if needed.
